messages:
maya: Quick sync — Q3 observability roadmap, need to lock scope for dashboards, trace retention, error analysis. Two enterprise asks (Acme, Nova) and infra cost concerns. Thoughts? :eyes:
liam: +1 on locking soon. main tradeoff is retention vs cost. we should propose a tiered model not full 1yr by default.
sarah: Storage estimates incoming. rough numbers: 30d traces at current sample ~6TB/mo; 90d ~18TB/mo. will post exact calc in PRD.
priya: UX note — many customers want simple defaults. propose "90d recommended (paid tier 1)" and a basic 30d free tier. advanced per-route override tucked away.
ben: For launch criteria: 1) dashboards for top 10 routes with latency + error rate, 2) configurable sampling (global + per-route), 3) basic error grouping + stack links, 4) admin retention UI + billing calc, 5) alpha with 2 customers.
maya: Acme specifically asked for 365d retention and ability to export traces. Nova wants per-route 100% on error routes.
liam: For Dedicated/Private we can offer 365d as config. Hosted customers: 30d default, 365d add-on. we need quota enforcement and billing knobs.
sarah: Risk: cost blowouts if sampling spikes. mitigation: hard caps, default sampling floor, alerts on ingestion growth. also need query timeouts to protect the console.
priya: Wireframes for the admin UI (dropdown retention, cost estimator, per-route overrides) ready: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/obs-retention-ui — will attach in PRD. keep it minimal.
eva: FYI ops: adding retention tiers requires DB lifecycle jobs + retention enforcement. estimate 3 wks infra work + 1 wk rollout testing.
ben: Also include an automatic error-insights MVP: group by stacktrace fingerprint, show top 3 suspects, and link to traces. no ML yet, simple heuristic grouping.
maya: Launch plan proposal: alpha (Acme, Nova) 2 weeks, beta (10 customers) 6 weeks, GA after 10 weeks if no major regressions. metrics to monitor: ingestion GB/day, cost per GB, query 95/99 latency, error grouping false-positive rate.
liam: Agree. Need a canary for cost: monitor month-over-month cost delta for sample customers, set alert threshold at +25%.
sarah: I'll drop storage + cost sheets in the PRD by EOD and include a few cost scenarios (30d/90d/365d).
priya: UX decision: default sampling 1% global, 100% for error traces or user-marked routes. per-route override UI limited to org admins.
ben: Action items: @sarah prepare PRD w/ numbers, @ben draft launch checklist & observability dashboards, @priya finalize wireframes & prototype, @liam estimate infra + quotas, @eva schedule alpha customers.
maya: Quick thumbs — accept this scope? :thumbsup: / :thumbsdown:
ben: +1
liam: +1
sarah: +1
priya: +1
eva: +1
maya: Locking scope. We'll reconvene in 48h to review PRD and infra estimate. deploy-bot: created PR #1423 for initial spec (https://git.redwood/proj/1423).
